quotes.text: Todas las preguntas de la sección se reﬁeren a la actividad principal, excepto donde se indica.
Habitualmente, ¿cuántas horas y días trabaja a la semana?

assessments.reasoning: Section H of the questionnaire captures hours worked strictly in relation to employment/paid activities (main and secondary activities). The survey does not include questions or modules asking respondents how they allocate or spend time across daily non-paid activities, such as unpaid domestic work, care work, education, or leisure. Therefore, the instrument does not capture time use across multiple daily activities.
